verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de offers a notarization API that creates requests, manages signers, auto-detects signature fields and sends webhooks. Nothing in the pack shows an embeddable signing UI, such as an iframe, SDK, embedded session URL or white-label signing component. API-driven request creation and a hosted "secure portal" are adjacent capabilities, not in-app embedded signing, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the signing experience inside my own app or website
